import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose

theorem lg_target : Nat.choose 10 3 = 120 := by
  have h1 : Nat.choose 10 3 = (10 * 9 * 8) / (3 * 2 * 1) :=
    Nat.choose_eq_factorial_div_factorial.trans $ Nat.choose_eq_fact_div_fact
  have h2 : (10 * 9 * 8) / (3 * 2 * 1) = 120 :=
    by norm_num
  rw [h1, h2]
